notes: Privilege escalation in sudo. Command executed without validating sudoers permissions when EDITOR env var is set. Fixed by adding validate_permissions() before execute. CVE-2023-22809
Privilege escalation via user namespace. cgroup release_agent allows unprivileged user to execute commands as root. Fixed by adding capability validation before credential commit.
Privilege escalation via Kubernetes volume mount. Pod Security admission bypass allows mounting host paths without validation. Fixed by adding validate_pod_security() check.
Container breakout via runc WORKDIR. Special file descriptors leak into container allowing host filesystem escape. Fixed by adding masked path validation before file operations.
Row-level security bypass in PostgreSQL. SECURITY INVOKER function accesses tables without enforcing row-level policies. Fixed by adding check_row_security() before table access.
